title: Levying the Statutory Tax on a Hotel Rate Plans Stay
content:
The authorities levy a statutory tax on the room money for a Hotel Rate Plans stay, and that tax is charged to the reservation and shown on its folio as a tax line.

## What governs the charge

**The statutory tax due is settled only once the folio's room lines carry every occupant beyond the rate plan's standard occupancy for the nights of the stay already posted.** While the folio's room lines fall short of carrying every such occupant for those nights, the statutory tax due is not settled.

The result governed is the statutory tax due on the room money for the stay. Once the charge is recorded, the tax joins what the guest owes for the stay and stands on the folio as a tax line; nothing else on the reservation moves.

## The capability that records it

`post_statutory_tax_charge_0b7e8f18` charges a hotel guest the statutory tax the authorities levy on the room money for their stay. One call posts a single statutory tax line to the named reservation's folio for the amount stated.

## How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk. It is not a tool the guest runs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | the internal reference number of the hotel reservation the tax is levied on | an identifier, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call |
| `statutory_tax_amount_usd` | the statutory tax due on the stay | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the second decimal and at no earlier point, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol; zero is written 0.0 and means no statutory tax is due |

Neither parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A single line of confirmation text. It names the reference of the statutory tax line just created on the folio, the reference of the reservation it was posted to, and the amount charged as a USD figure with two decimal places. The text coming back at all is what indicates the line was posted; an absent line or an error text means the folio is untouched.
